question.text: Category III AIFs enjoy 'tax pass-through' status under Section 115UB of the Income Tax Act, 1961:

answer.text: No — tax pass-through under Section 115UB applies only to Cat I and Cat II AIFs
Yes but only for capital gains

explanation.text: The Logic: Per Section 9.1, Section 115UB defines 'Investment Fund' as Cat I or Cat II AIFs; Cat III AIFs are NOT accorded tax pass-through. The Trap: All claims of pass-through for Cat III are incorrect — this is the key distinguishing feature. Cross-Exam Context: Critical distinction between XIX-A (Cat I/II, pass-through) and XIX-B (Cat III, fund-level tax). Distributor's Pro-Tip: Clients comparing Cat I/II vs III must understand fund-level vs investor-level taxation — it materially affects post-tax returns.
